abstract: An 18-year-old male with Klinefelter's syndrome presented with a mature teratoma of the mediastinum. He was treated with debulking surgery and brief cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Ten years later, he presented with paraplegia and was found to have an isolated epidural mass. The mass was composed of mature histiocytoid cells reminiscent of those seen in malignant histiocytosis. There was no evidence of medullary dissemination and there was no evidence of recurrence of the germ cell tumor. He received local radiation therapy and a single course of leukemic induction. He remains well 4 years later. This case represents a localized variant of the diffuse histiocytic malignancies associated with malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors.
abstract_ja: 18歳のクラインフェルター症候群の男性が縦隔の成熟奇形腫を呈した。減量手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法を短期間施行した。10年後、対麻痺を呈し、孤立性の硬膜外腫瘤が認められた。この腫瘤は悪性組織球症を想起させる成熟組織球様細胞から構成されていた。髄内播種は認められず、胚細胞腫瘍の再発も認められなかった。局所放射線療法と白血病寛解導入療法を施行した。4年後も良好な状態を保っている。本症例は、悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に伴うびまん性組織球性悪性疾患の限局型である。
